input.summary: Ported fuzz.cu to fuzz.cpp in plain SYCL 2020. It has no dpct headers, helpers or macros, and it compiles without the dpct include path. The kernel is a 1-D parallel_for over n samples, using USM device memory and queue profiling for the timing. On a 1 s test sine, the maximum difference from the reference binary is 1.2e-7. That is well inside the 1e-5 tolerance. I tested only that one 16-bit mono 44.1 kHz file.
